column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to undertake, promote and facilitate studies in the
field of Economics within and outside Sri Lanka;
to  organize  and  promote  research  in  the  field  of
Economics  and  undertake  studies  and  research
projects on contract from government, private and
international  agencies  or  institutions;
to  plan  and  organize  teaching  and  training
programmes in the field of  Economics;
to train students and others in research methodology
with  the  idea  of  promoting  knowledge  and
awareness in subjects relevant to economics;
to  assist  in  the  formulation  of  effective  socio-
economic  policies;
to prepare and submit reports on issues relating to
economic  and  social  development  or  to  prepare

reports 
on 
studies 
relating 
to 
economic
development;
to  promote  understanding,  co-operation  and
friendship  with  similar  associations  within  and
outside Sri Lanka; and
to  undertake,  promote  and  conduct  on  its  own
initiative or in collaboration with local or foreign
associations such surveys and studies on economic
and social development in the international sphere
and more particularly in Sri Lanka.
